text:
deploy-bot: Deploy attempted for release v2.18.0 -> prod. SECURITY GATE: SBOM integrity check FAILED. Affected artifact: /ci/artifacts/sbom-1759123456.json. Blocked by policy 'sbom-integrity-v1'.

alex: ugh. any hint which package?

deploy-bot: quick diff attached inline.
```
- package: libc-compat
  version: 2.34
  source: image:sha256:aaa111
+ package: libc-compat
  version: 2.31
  source: image:sha256:bbb222
```

sarah-qa: so staging built with baseimage A (sha256:aaa111) but prod job pulled baseimage B (sha256:bbb222)?

jonah: looks like a provenance mismatch — the base image digest changed between CI and registry mirror. Could be transient mirror lag or someone pushed an older tag.

ci-bot: Vulnerability scan for v2.18.0 completed: high/critical CVEs = 0. Signature verification = PASS. SBOM provenance check = FAIL (base-image-digest mismatch).

legal: tagging for compliance review. If we force through we'll need an exception and an audit note. Not ideal.

ops-oncall: what are the rollback options? we have a change window until 18:00 UTC. If we hold, we need a mitigation for traffic routing.

alex: options: 1) pin to baseimage digest from staging (rebuild prod images), 2) roll back to previous release v2.17.9, 3) request exception from security/compliance (fast, but tracked).

jonah: rebuilding now with pinned digest (sha256:aaa111) would be quickest to preserve artifact parity. I can trigger a rebuild but need approval to unblock the release bot.

sarah-qa: can we run a smoke canary once rebuilt? reqd before full rollout.

deploy-bot: automatic rollback not performed. Holding rollout. Awaiting human approval.

legal: we can approve a controlled rebuild + canary if security signs off. I'll flag compliance and note the audit trail.

alex: i'm +1 for rebuild+pin+canary. jonah, please open a hotfix branch and small PR with rebuild. tag @security and @qa.

jonah: creating branch release/v2.18.0-hotfix-pin now. PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/5421

ci-bot: CI triggered for PR #5421. SBOM generation step will capture baseimage digest.

sarah-qa: running smoke tests when CI green. will smoke canary on canary-1 for 15m.

ops-oncall: scheduling canary window 30m after CI green, rollback if any errors > 1% 5xxs or latency > 200ms p95.

deploy-bot: Note: if canary fails, automatic fallback will roll traffic to v2.17.9 and re-enqueue release for triage.

alex: update: security wants a short blameless note in the PR explaining why the digest diverged (mirror push or manual re-tag). keep it factual.

jonah: added note in PR and attached sbom diff + registry audit lines.

ci-bot: PR #5421 CI green. SBOM now shows baseimage digest sha256:aaa111. SBOM integrity check PASSED for rebuilt artifact.

sarah-qa: canary started on canary-1. smoke tests passing at +10m.

ops-oncall: canary metrics look normal at +20m. holding for full 30m.

legal: compliance acknowledges rebuild and canary. no exception needed. good job. :thumbsup:

alex: rolling to prod now. deploy-bot, proceed.

deploy-bot: Rolling v2.18.0 -> prod. Security gate checks re-run post-deploy.

ci-bot: Post-deploy SBOM sanity check = PASS. Post-deploy vuln scan = PASS. All gates green.

jonah: closing hotfix branch after monitoring window.

sarah-qa: monitoring for 1h, then we'll mark release as stable if metrics hold.

alex: final note — add a follow-up to ops playbook: add registry digest pin verification step earlier in CI to catch mirror-to-mirror drift.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by deploy-bot.
